hooks.note: Upstream 371f1f364 and 75939ca5b moved swift-zip-archive to 750253d, whose ZipArchiveReader.extract throws invalidFilePath before writing anything when an entry path is absolute or has a '..' component. The Swift diff of Settings.swift does not show it, so the translation never sees it.

URL.documentsDirectory is the sandboxed Documents folder. The translation derived it from java.io.tmpdir, whose parent is the app data directory next to shared_prefs, databases and files, so createAndGetDirectory() and the settings import wrote there. Documents.directory is <filesDir>/Documents and moves what older versions left in the old place once, before its first use.
Swift keeps controlBarBackgroundImagePath in URL.documentsDirectory, where the settings import extracts it by name.
Swift keeps stealthModeImagePath in URL.documentsDirectory, where the settings import extracts it by name.

hooks.new: check(root.canonicalFile.toPath().let { base -> entries.all { File(root, it.name).canonicalFile.toPath().startsWith(base) } }) { "Invalid file path" }
hooks.note: HSYS.2 is the lexical check of swift-zip-archive. java.io.File also treats a backslash or a drive letter as a separator on a Windows JVM, where the unit tests run, and follows symlinks, so every entry must also resolve inside Documents.directory before anything is written.
